notes.text: The Yerushalmi twice attributes the explanation of the Amos passage to Rabbi Chaggai in Rabbi Yaavetz’s name.
The Midrash reports the corresponding explanations of creating mountains and wind and of chaos and darkness. It names Rav Huna as the transmitter, in contrast with the Yerushalmi’s Rabbi Chaggai.
Rav Huna is the named transmitter in this parallel. The sentence is retained and no second link to the same target is needed.
